entities.name: János Kiss
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Kiss was a Hungarian military officer and the military leader of the Hungarian Committee for Liberation and National Uprising. On 22 November 1944, he was arrested by the pro-Nazi Hungarian secret police on a meeting of that committee along with other resistance leaders. He was executed on 8 December 1944.

entities.name: János Kiss
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Kiss was a Hungarian military officer and the military leader of the Hungarian Committee for Liberation and National Uprising. On 22 November 1944, he was arrested by the pro-Nazi Hungarian secret police on a meeting of that committee along with other resistance leaders. He was executed on 8 December 1944.
